inlines.v: R'AFT, noun [Gr. to sew that is, to fasten together, and allied to reeve; or Gr. whence a flooring. See Rafter and Roof.] An assemblage of boards, planks or pieces of timber fastened together horizontally and floated down a stream; a float. R'AFT, participle passive [Latin rapio; bereafian, to snatch away, to bereave.] Torn; rent; severed. obsolete
